name: TokenRouter.io
notes: Bring-your-own-key gateway: the operator adds their own provider keys to the TokenRouter.io account, and each provider bills its tokens directly. A model works only if the account holds a key for that model's provider; otherwise TokenRouter.io answers 400 provider_key_missing. TokenRouter.io itself charges a flat monthly plan with a request cap (Free $0 with 1,000 requests a month and 2 providers, Starter $29 with 1M requests, Team $99 with 10M, Enterprise from $499) and no per-token markup, so each model carries the provider list price TokenRouter.io shows. Keys start with tr_ and go in Authorization: Bearer. No exhaustedErrorCodes: 429 budget_exceeded (a team, member or key hard cap) and 429 monthly_quota_exceeded (the plan's request cap) are left as a Cooldown, since the operator can raise the budget or the plan at any time; 429 rate_limit_exceeded carries Retry-After. No Terms Risk: the terms (last updated 2026-08-07) forbid in §5 to "resell the Service without our prior written consent", which routing one's own traffic through the gateway is not, and say nothing about proxies, key sharing or single-person use. Prompts and completions are not stored by default and never used for training. Not shipped: openai/text-embedding-3-small (no embedding Model Kind) and the virtual auto, auto:cost, auto:latency and auto:quality models.
